notes.note: Reviewed for #4992: listSessionReadModel now takes a required internal caller purpose used only for telemetry (no result or authority change); the event store's batched session-projection reads gain an optional cache-outcome observer; peer hosting check reads the one derived record with the caller's authority; spatial board resolves only referenced Sessions with the same readability. No documented route, payload, authority or configuration claim in this page changes; the new metrics and diagnostics bundle field are documented in monitoring.md, metrics.md and cli.md.
